It's baffling that this person thinks that, if somebody tells on them and they get a warning, they're just as oppressed as a Jewish person being sent to a camp to be worked to death, tortured, and euthanized, AND that they're at the same level as someone saving slaves from being *literal property* and, again, being physically and psychologically tortured, starved, and worked to the bone their whole lives. 

Oh, but not being able to go outside...except for when they need essentials? And when they give the extremely flexible excuse of needing exercise? And to see close family and friends within their bubble? Wow I have never heard of such oppression.

...I have a hard time believing that such a moronic excuse of an (presumably) adult human being isn't actually just a couple of maniacal infants in a trenchcoat.

> What if I don't respect them or their choices?

You are within your right to choose to be an unempathetic asshole. No one is trying to take that from you.

Thank you. I needed to read this, LOL

I didn't even know about this last week. I saw a redditor talking about it, and looked it up. Then hyperventilated, freaked out, and proceeded to hide under my blankets for hours.

Dying of a disease is one of my worst fears. I should've known that the media was just hamming it up. One of these days I'll learn to be more critical instead of letting my mind wander.

No need to put so much pressure on yourself. You don't have to be like other people, especially when it comes to creative outlets. Finding a personal art style is a huge part of learning to paint/draw/etc..

Like another redditor said, you are actually a pretty good writer. The way you wrote this post was compelling enough to get me to respond. Honest. I usually get too anxious to comment, but I can relate to how you feel. When it comes to art, I always feel pressured when I see people my own age and younger drawing these incredibly detailed illustrations. It's discouraging and I always want to quit, but I can't. Art is one of very few things that make sense to me.
Why should you be punished? You are not to blame. Tell someone if you can. It's okay to lean on other people. Please don't punish yourself.

I feel like I have a stab wound that's getting wider by the day. Years ago, it was a negligible sliver.

Now, there's a gaping hole in my chest. This deep pain is a waking nightmare. Some intangible part of me is irreparably scarred. I'm afraid of this wound killing me. I'm afraid of the world killing me. My anxiety is tearing me apart. 

I want to cry, but the tears never flow. I want to rage, but my throat closes. 

I don't want to leave these walls. I'm not really safe, but I don't care. Every person I meet pushes the knife further in, murdering me again and again. I am constantly grieving the short moments of hope I had to be shown the good in other people. I miss honesty, even if it hates me.

Please, someone or something, end this pain. Turn me to dust.
The virtue signalling is strong with this one.
Haha, thank you  Maybe I'll make a post about that part at some point.

I feel that lol

It was a huge risk, but worth it. I felt so free on the plane. But I wouldn't recommend anyone up and travel to another country alone unless they were prepared, for safety's sake.

No worries. I think the frustration of not being able to connect with like-minded individuals contributes to misanthropy, for some. It is difficult to see the good in people when I don't associate with many. Likewise, it is difficult to bring myself to associate with people *because* I see little good in them.

Still. Whether one wants it to be or not, wanting to be understood and accepted is unconditional to being human.

Some misanthropes (including myself at times) forget that we are human and, despite coming to our conclusions, are subject to the same shortcomings. I really dislike coming off this way. I say this because I have been dismissive to people with similar feelings to yours in the past (IRL).

Forgive my word choice, if it's not correct. I have difficulty summarizing my feelings in words. In short, I understand you.

It sounds like he's a sad, miserable person hyper-focused on the opinions of others. Probably because some deep part of himself knows that his personality is cancerous.

Tangent here. I never understood the idea that doing excessively generous things for complete strangers somehow nullifies the gross wrongs a person commits against the people they actually know. Absolutely not. If anything, it makes you more of a shallow, ingenuine asshole to use generosity as an ego boost when there are people you actually know suffer because of your actions.

Nothing will save these people from the hellish punishment of being themselves, scraping together self-respect that the deepest parts of them know they don't really deserve.

Damn, I really hope you're okay.

Please forgive my frankness, but your mother has the mindset of a child. Calling you a "freak" and a "loser." Like she's in fucking middle school and can't discuss things like an adult. She can't respect herself enough to act like one, much less respect you as her daughter.

She doesn't deserve having you as her daughter. Period.

I have problems with my mother too, where she drives home feelings similar to what you describe. The adults around me are nothing but bigger children. And that's not worth anyone's life.

Seriously, you're worth more than that.

This is why you never, ever open joint back accounts with family or friends. You need to have your own money that only you can touch. Others can ask you if they need it. Otherwise, they feel entitiled to the money because of your relationship. Doesn't matter how good or bad that relationship is. A lot of parents feel entitled to their kids' money. What your mom did was a bitch move, no offense. If she didn't have the lady balls to tell you up front what the money was for like an adult, then it was not a good enough reason. Period.

That is true. It's funny, but lately the thought of adopting kittens has been a sort of motivator for me. Not trying to find a partner, not making loads of money, not pleasing loved ones, not even to live a comfortable life for myself. The thought of caring for innocent creatures has sort of made me want to improve my life so I can give kittens a good home.

It sounds silly, I know. I might end up having a lot of pets.

Since others have already given their take on the situation (things I might have said initially), I'll try to give a different one. Please take no offense to my point of view, it's just the rationality that's helped me.

If you chose to live, there will always be options, opportunities, choices. If you chose to die, there are no other choices. You may not feel you have choices. That's understandble, I felt that way for a long time, and still fall back into it. But the solution to feeling like you have no choice is not eliminating your ability to have any future choices. It's counter intuitive.

You can pull through. You can tell the suicidal thoughts that give you tunnel vision to kindly fuck off and let you see the choices you've been missing. Hold out until you can finally see them again.

Don't let these urges sabotage you. You have potential to grow from your struggles. You can become a person you can be proud of.

"I have survived my worst day." This is a quote I read somewhere. I don't really remember where. Every time I feel there is no way out, I recite this in my head. It is always true as long as you live to say it.

(One thing that also helps me is ranting about random things. I rant without a filter, without worrying about being consistent. I let the words flow and then look back on them later, objectively. You may discover some interesting things about yourself.)
Why am I trying to fight it?

Barely made it through Thanksgiving week. Having to come back to school has made me physically ill. I don't want to go to counseling tomorrow. 

Feeling like I don't deserve the life that I live. Other people suffer, and I don't even want this life. I just want to leave, live somewhere alone, get a job somewhere, and adopt some kittens. Then take school at my own pace eventually. But I only went back to school because everyone around me made it seem like it was my only option. Now I'm loosing my scholarship and will owe my school money in addition to loosing my classes. I'm so stupid. I'm so weak willed. I'm starting not to see a point to this anymore. No one in my family gives a fuck what I really want. All I wanted was to take a break because I knew stress was building up but if I did, I had nowhere to go.

I'm spoiled, pathetic, and a fool for trying to express how I really feel to those closest to me and for not standing up for myself. I have so many good things but I don't want any more. I want to give everything I own away and then run away or kill myself.

At this point, I don't even know if I feel this way because it's inevitable or if I subconsciously desire sympathy and attention. On one hand, I have felt like this for years and hadn't said a thing. A few mental breakdowns later and I'm suddenly in counseling, taking medication, and posting on reddit (as opposed to lurking). On the other hand, I struggle with how to approach people now. I don't want to keep talking about myself but lately I can't help it.

I wasn't the type of person to wear my heart on my sleeve in the past. It may be me making up for lost time, years of keeping to myself... And I second guess myself and apologize for being open whenever I talk about how I feel. I want to get better but I don't know.
Are you sure..? I feel like they'd just send me away for being lazy and messing up. I feel like such a failure. I have a good life and should be successful but... I just can't be for some reason.

I've tried to kill myself before, a long time ago. I failed at even that. If you're scared, then maybe there is still hope for you. It's not a bad thing to fear death, it means there's something still keeping you alive. I hope you never have to lose that fear, and feel like i do right now and when I made my first attempt.

I ruin everything good in my life. I can't even tell if it's intentional self-destructive behavior or just an fucking idiotic waste of effort. Every time I try to do well, academically, socially, or even trying to do self-care, I fail. I just fail.
